## Professional aspirations

I enjoy synthesizing policy, science, data, and socio-economic data into actionable reports. My background completing my degree in environmental studies from Vassar College focused in marine conservation, biology, and anthropology. Adding data analysis skills to my portfolio will allow me to better address complex environmental issues. I am excited to apply my new found data skills to my passion of environmental investigations. 
 
## Hobbies 

I love being outside! My favorite activities are swimming leisurely in the ocean, jogging to the beach, hiking, and kayaking. I also love art. I enjoy ceramics, print making, and collaging. One of my other great passions is travelling.
